name: claude-mind-manager
description: Region-based context management for Claude Code. 6 commands: /mind-claudemd, /mind-memory, /mind-rules, /mind-files, /mind-update, /mind-session-log. v3.2.1 hotfix: mind-session-log path cross-platform (cygpath), mind-update now scans ALL custom context (global rules + MEMORY topic files), dead-path algorithm strict (no false-positives), auto-fix 4-class classification (AUTO/ASK/DESIGN/DEAD) with coupled-files detection. 2 agents, 1 hook. Claude Code CLI only (not Desktop). Zero dependencies.
